raw_snippet: STP is launching with a foundational set of partnerships comprising four high-performing IT services firms; ClearFuze Networks, IronOrbit, Delval Technology Solutions (DTS), and OneNet Global.
value_text: announced as joining its group: IronOrbit (IT managed-service provider, USA)
note: One of four launch MSPs. Shield calls its deals 'partnerships'; SiliconANGLE and Channel Dive report they are majority/controlling stakes (60-90%). Price not disclosed. Date: Date Shield launched and named the four firms; individual closing dates not published.
